title: Acquisition and consolidation — Pine Co. and Spruce Co.
instructions: On January 1, Year 1, Pine Co. acquired **100%** of Spruce Co.'s voting stock for **$1,100,000** cash. Prepare the acquisition-date elimination and selected Year 1 consolidated amounts.

exhibits.title: Spruce Co. at acquisition
exhibits.content:
| Item | Book value | Fair value |
|---|---:|---:|
| Net assets other than equipment | 700,000 | 700,000 |
| Equipment (5-year remaining life) | 200,000 | 300,000 |
| Common stock | 300,000 | |
| Retained earnings | 600,000 | |

exhibits.title: Year 1 operations
exhibits.content:
- Sales: Pine $2,000,000; Spruce $800,000
- Cost of goods sold: Pine $1,200,000; Spruce $500,000
- During Year 1, **Spruce sold goods to Pine for $200,000** that had cost Spruce $150,000. At December 31, Pine still held **40%** of these goods.

parts.explanation: Eliminate Spruce's equity (900,000), write equipment up to fair value (+100,000), and record goodwill = 1,100,000 − (900,000 + 100,000) = 100,000.

rows.label: Unrealized intercompany profit in ending inventory
Consolidated cost of goods sold (before excess depreciation)
Additional depreciation on the equipment write-up
